correctness.rationale: Universal-cover simplicial identification establishes the deck lattice and H1 integrally; a sharp six-step displacement norm is proved for every class by lower bounds and explicit paths; exact integer inequalities leave six nonzero norm-four vectors. Coordinate saturation forces precisely three step multisets and 13 translated unoriented simple cycles for each class. An index-13 basis determinant proves primitivity, and multiplier 4 proves symmetry transitivity. A standalone exhaustive verifier independently enumerates all 78 quadrilaterals, their integral displacements, triangles, links, and affine orbits, and checks the norm for a finite radius; the universal length theorem uses the symbolic proof rather than extrapolation. The same actual verifier output is bundled.

value.rationale: The 13-vertex example is the first flag triangulation within the distinguished Datta--Upadhyay cyclic torus family. Its three equally short primitive integral homology directions contrast with the proved n>=17 one-direction tail. The exact 39-carrier census, 13+13+13 distribution, affine transitivity, and complete marked walk-length formula provide motivated structural information for a canonical regular torus complex beyond Betti numbers, a routine consistency check, or an arbitrary parameter slice.
